title: Phenotype-centered subgraph source and corpus ledger
scope: Public or individually accessible sources for target identity, observation normalization, phenotype-centered candidate subgraphs, source-backed executable cards, and residual disease/document retrieval.

inherited_source_audit.purpose: This focused ledger adds target-subgraph sources, including a new PubTator entry. The inherited audit remains authoritative for the local CPG corpus and its explicitly named WikEM, DisMech, PubMed and DiagRL artifacts; it is not superseded by omission here.
inherited_source_audit.guard: WikEM stays in a separate BY-SA layer; DisMech remains quarantined; every local CPG chunk retains its per-source rights gate; PubMed and the focused ledger's PubTator entry provide discovery/passage routing rather than a uniform full-text license.

global_decision: Use immutable ontologies for identity and hierarchy, a provenance-bearing text overlay for candidate typed edges, and a reviewed rule-card layer for T/F/U entailment. Never enumerate global two- or three-finding combinations or invert disease-phenotype associations into definitions.

algorithm_references.name: Phenomizer and HPO semantic profile matching
algorithm_references.mechanism_to_reuse: Information-content/MICA semantic similarity and best-match comparison between a query HPO profile and annotated target profiles; avoids pair/triple enumeration.
algorithm_references.boundary: Requires correctly asserted HPO terms and disease annotations; does not define a higher-order phenotype from components.

algorithm_references.name: LIRICAL
algorithm_references.mechanism_to_reuse: Interpretable per-phenotype likelihood ratios using observed/excluded HPO terms and annotation frequencies.
algorithm_references.boundary: Primarily hereditary/genomic disease prioritization; not a component-to-syndrome definition engine and is sensitive to assertion/linking quality.

algorithm_references.name: Monarch PumpkinPy / OWLSim method family
algorithm_references.mechanism_to_reuse: Ontology closure, information-content bitmaps and Resnik/PhenoDigm/profile similarity for scalable target search.
algorithm_references.boundary: Semantic proximity and shared ancestors are proposal signals, not clinical entailment.

algorithm_references.name: phenopy
algorithm_references.mechanism_to_reuse: Weighted best-match averaging and frequency-aware semantic similarity over generic HPO-annotated entities.
algorithm_references.boundary: Repository/content licenses and HPOA source rights need review; it does not supply phenotype definitions.

sources.name: Human Phenotype Ontology (HPO)
sources.version_or_snapshot: repository-frozen hp.obo release 2026-02-16; a newer public release was separately audited but was not used by this probe
sources.license: HPO custom license; preserve attribution, citation, release date and official logical content
safe_roles: definitions and comments as candidate text
obsolete status and replacement metadata for quarantine and explicitly reviewed migration; never automatic following
forbidden_inferences: co-occurring sibling findings define a parent syndrome
definition mentions are automatically executable criteria
local edges may overwrite HPO content
sources.redistribution_guard: Keep mined aliases and edges in a separate local namespace and carry the exact HPO release and license.

sources.name: HPO disease annotations (HPOA)
sources.license: HPO terms plus upstream row-level source restrictions; OMIM-derived rows require special care
safe_roles: frequency, onset and explicit negative metadata
forbidden_inferences: unfiltered redistribution of restricted upstream rows
sources.redistribution_guard: Retain source/evidence columns and exclude or separately license restricted source rows.

sources.name: Mondo Disease Ontology
sources.version_or_snapshot: repository-frozen mondo.obo release 2026-05-05; later public releases were not used by this probe
sources.license: CC BY 4.0
forbidden_inferences: disease definitions as unreviewed executable component rules
xrefs as clinical equivalence without scope review
sources.redistribution_guard: Retain attribution and exact release provenance; separate local clinical rules.

sources.name: PHENIO
sources.version_or_snapshot: official repository commit 1b480838c84bca51a12c35e36146c773d69da228 audited 2026-08-25; release artifact not pulled
sources.license: Unresolved artifact-level metadata conflict: repository LICENSE is BSD-3-Clause, phenio-edit.owl declares CC BY 4.0, src/metadata/phenio.md declares CC BY 3.0, and the ontology profile reports missing_ontology_license; imported sources retain their own rights
forbidden_inferences: license-clean derivative release before artifact and imported-source rights are reconciled
sources.redistribution_guard: Pin an exact release artifact and hash; retain its embedded license plus imported-source provenance; do not place PHENIO in the license-clean redistributable core until the conflicting metadata is reconciled.

sources.name: Symptom Ontology (SYMP)
sources.license: CC0
safe_roles: subjective symptom labels, synonyms and hierarchy
sources.redistribution_guard: Pin the release and retain local extensions separately.

sources.name: Disease Ontology
safe_roles: supplementary disease and syndrome target identity
forbidden_inferences: free-text definitions as executable rules without review
sources.redistribution_guard: Pin the exact release and test parsers against production-format changes.

sources.name: Monarch Knowledge Graph
sources.license: Integrated edges retain heterogeneous upstream licenses and provenance
sources.redistribution_guard: Preserve primary_knowledge_source and upstream license metadata per edge.

sources.name: Orphadata phenotype annotations
sources.license: CC BY 4.0
sources.redistribution_guard: Retain release, language, OrphaCode, frequency and assertion semantics.

sources.name: LOINC2HPO
sources.license: Upstream License.md permits software reuse with notices, keeps incorporated LOINC content under the LOINC license, and states that the laboratory-test interpretations are for academic research use only and should not be used for medical diagnosis without consultation with licensed medical professionals

local_snapshot_status.decision: NO-GO for routing until rebuilt from the frozen upstream TSV and audited row by row
local_snapshot_status.interpretation_guard: Strict mismatch is an identity quarantine signal; it does not mean all 58 rows have been manually adjudicated as clinical errors.

safe_roles: offline academic-research proposal from an already identified LOINC plus interpreted result direction/value to HPO
candidate atomic normalization with licensed-clinician oversight before any medical use
forbidden_inferences: clinical deployment or diagnostic advice from the annotation interpretations without legal review and licensed-medical-professional consultation
sources.redistribution_guard: Pin the commit; include the upstream copyright/permission text, LOINC notice and any third-party notices; apply frozen-HPO active-ID plus current-name/synonym identity gates; do not auto-follow obsolete replaced_by; label the mapping incomplete/stale and academic-research-only; quarantine the current processed JSON; do not present the interpretations as medical diagnosis without licensed-professional consultation.

sources.name: LOINC
sources.license: LOINC license and attribution terms
safe_roles: test/analyte, specimen, method and property identity
forbidden_inferences: abnormality direction without value, unit and reference context
sources.redistribution_guard: Accept and retain the current LOINC license; keep local interpretations separate.

sources.name: UCUM
sources.license: UCUM terms permit interoperability use while restricting modification/competing standards
sources.redistribution_guard: Keep the official unit tables unmodified and attribute UCUM.

sources.name: RadLex
sources.license: RadLex License Agreement and Terms of Use v2.1, effective 2025-01-06
safe_roles: radiology finding, anatomy and modality identity
sources.redistribution_guard: Carry the v2.1 agreement and notices, identify changes and non-endorsement prominently, and keep local aliases/edges in a layer marked as based on RadLex; do not modify official RIDs, names, synonyms or original ontologic relations.

sources.name: NCBI MedGen
sources.license: US-government material is public domain; contributed vocabularies retain upstream rights
sources.redistribution_guard: Filter by SAB, semantic type and rights holder; retain MedGen and source identifiers.

sources.name: PMC Open Access Subset and PMC AWS Open Data
sources.version_or_snapshot: updated AWS article-version service and post-August-24 legacy retirement notices audited 2026-08-25
sources.license: Article-level licenses; open-access participation does not imply one uniform license
safe_roles: targeted definitions, review text, diagnostic criteria and methods/guideline passages
language variants and source-backed candidate edges
forbidden_inferences: BY-ND, BY-NC-ND, custom, null/no-CC or TDM-only text transformed into a published derivative graph without separate authorization
sources.redistribution_guard: Gate every article version on AWS metadata license_code and the in-article license. The permissive derivative overlay is CC0/CC BY only; BY-SA has a separate share-alike release and NC a separate noncommercial layer. Exclude BY-ND, BY-NC-ND, custom, null/no-CC and TDM-only author manuscripts from transformed/published graphs unless separately authorized. Retain PMCID/version/section/sentence/offsets. The legacy OA API is unavailable and legacy FTP/AWS paths were scheduled for removal on or after 2026-08-24; use the updated AWS article-version structure.

sources.name: Europe PMC
sources.license: Metadata/service terms plus article-level full-text rights
forbidden_inferences: uniform reuse rights for all linked articles
sources.redistribution_guard: Retain article-level license and PMCID/version; treat annotations as proposals.

sources.name: PubTator 3
sources.version_or_snapshot: public API and BioC services audited 2026-08-25
sources.license: NCBI service/data terms plus underlying article rights
sources.redistribution_guard: Retain source document identifiers and article rights; add an independent HPO/RadLex linker.

sources.name: CDC-owned publications and web content
sources.license: Most US federal government-created CDC material is public domain; third-party content is excluded
safe_roles: source-sentence candidates for infectious disease and public-health syndrome definitions, held for manual and legal review
forbidden_inferences: webpage prose is an executable criterion without scope review
automatic committed derivative graph before the substantive-content condition is legally reconciled
sources.redistribution_guard: Quarantine as source-sentence/manual candidates by default. For any reuse, verify item-level CDC/ATSDR/HHS ownership and jurisdiction; exclude contractor, grantee, licensed third-party, state and local material; provide agency attribution, a prominent non-endorsement disclaimer, do not alter substantive content, and state that the original is freely available on the agency website. Obtain legal review before publishing transformed graph edges.

sources.name: WHO open-access publications
sources.license: WHO publications issued since 2016-11-12 generally use CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 IGO; verify each item
safe_roles: standard and definition candidates in a separate NC-SA layer
forbidden_inferences: mixing NC-SA derivatives into a permissive corpus
WHO endorsement of the local system
sources.redistribution_guard: Retain IGO attribution, license and non-endorsement language; segregate the layer.

sources.name: NCBI Bookshelf open-access or public-domain titles
sources.license: Title-level rights vary; only explicit OA/LitArch/public-domain or compatible CC titles qualify
safe_roles: manual validation and selected definition candidates
forbidden_inferences: free-to-read means text-mining or redistribution rights
all Bookshelf titles share one license
sources.redistribution_guard: Record and enforce title-level license. For automated bulk acquisition, use only the NLM Literature Archive open-access subset through its designated FTP route; do not bulk ingest other Bookshelf titles.

sources.name: CQL and HL7 Clinical Practice Guidelines artifacts
sources.license: Artifact-specific; terminology value sets may have additional UMLS/VSAC restrictions
safe_roles: Boolean, threshold and temporal template proposals
forbidden_inferences: public syntax implies unrestricted value-set rights
sources.redistribution_guard: Audit each artifact and every referenced value set before redistribution.

sources.name: PheKB
sources.license: No single permissive license was verified for every artifact
safe_roles: criteria-structure examples for EHR cohort phenotypes
forbidden_inferences: uniform reuse of all uploaded artifacts
sources.redistribution_guard: Review the license and provenance of each artifact separately.

sources.name: OpenAlex

sources.license: Snapshot/data and metadata CC0; API use is subject to current key and usage terms
safe_roles: literature discovery, deduplication, OA location and license routing
sources.redistribution_guard: Use only as discovery metadata and follow the linked article license.

sources.name: StatPearls
sources.license: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 on audited titles
forbidden_inferences: committed derivative chunks or transformed graph as the primary corpus
sources.redistribution_guard: Do not include transformed text or a derived corpus without separate legal review.

sources.name: NICE Syndication and BNF
sources.license: NICE/BNF-specific reuse terms
sources.redistribution_guard: Obtain the appropriate permission/key and keep BNF out of automated scraping.

sources.name: S2ORC
sources.license: Current S2ORC bulk dataset is ODC-By 1.0 through the Semantic Scholar API, plus API usage terms; this database license does not replace underlying article rights
forbidden_inferences: dataset-level permission as uniform full-text reuse rights
sources.redistribution_guard: Preserve ODC-By attribution and API terms; prefer PMC OA for the default corpus and audit every underlying article if S2ORC is used.

sources.name: MedCPT Query and Article Encoders
sources.license: The model card and bundled LICENSE identify the NCBI model as public domain; the model card also carries a research/clinical-oversight disclaimer
forbidden_inferences: embedding similarity as a clinical relation or entailment
sources.redistribution_guard: Preserve the public-domain LICENSE and model disclaimer; record model commits, file hashes, runtime and pooling/normalization details. This commit does not redistribute the weights.

identity_and_type: PHENIO only as an optional pinned bridge after artifact-license reconciliation
observation_normalization: LOINC2HPO frozen upstream TSV after release/identity gating, for academic research only with legal and licensed-clinician governance; do not route through the current processed JSON
definition_and_language_overlay: Europe PMC for discovery and routing
CDC source-sentence candidates in legal/manual quarantine, not the automatic committed overlay
WHO in a separate NC-SA layer

not_pulled_rationale: The narrow falsification probe only required the HPO and Mondo snapshots already frozen in the repository plus temporary pinned MedCPT model checkouts. Pulling PHENIO, Monarch, Orphadata or a PMC bulk corpus would not validate proposition direction, article-level licensing or disease exposure and would create unnecessary large snapshots. They are therefore registered for P1/P2 role-specific acquisition rather than committed speculatively.
